name: Oasive
long_description: Oasive helps bond investors figure out which bonds are rich or cheap, and why. We give portfolio managers, traders, analysts and investment advisers a team of AI analysts, combining fixed income research, proprietary quantitative models and scenario analysis to move from trade idea to decision in minutes. Our focus is Macro and Rates Research and MBS, with munis, ABS and corporates next.
one_liner: Helping bond investors find what's rich or cheap, and why
